method: All mountain level-up entries are retained in source-learnsets.json; only entries whose move IDs occur in moves.v1.json are promoted to officialLearnset and level-up-moves.v1.json.

unsupportedMechanics.reason: HGSS high critical-hit ratio is not represented by the battle move schema.
These API targets are all-opponents, all-other-pokemon, field-wide, or users-field; those scopes are not encoded by the current move schema.
Variable power, party-dependent damage, conditional power, and one-hit-knockout effects are not supported.

movePolicy: These unsupported examples remain only in the unimplemented source learnset list and are excluded from runtime learnsets. Simple Ice attacks/status/stat effects and Feint Attack are imported with the exact HGSS parameters from PokéAPI.

deferredSpecies.name: Delibird
deferredSpecies.reason: Its only HGSS level-up move is Present, which has variable power and is not implemented. Keep defaultMoveIds empty; do not add Delibird to runtime encounters until an official move is supported.

implementedCombinedEffects.ice-fang: Source freeze and flinch each have a separate 10-percent chance; imported and covered by composition tests from local content 0.3.129.
